about:
# Plater-Nameplates
Source code for World of Warcraft addon Plater Nameplates.

General Frequent Asked Questions:
https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/plater-nameplates/pages/faq

General Scripting Guide:
https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/plater-nameplates/pages/scripts

The Wago.io logo was graciously provided for use within Plater by the owner and creator of Wago.io (Oratory).

releases.notes:
@cont1nuity:
- New option to enable blizzard nameplates 'advanced coloring'.
- Some improvements to pixel perfect layout.
- Fixing some issues with the 'Interrupt not ready' features.
- Fixing friends coloring.
- Fixing range checking for Forever.

@cont1nuity:
- Adding 'interrupt not ready coloring' feature.
- Fixing some issues around search layout and designer errors.
- Fixing some rune display issues.
- Fixing oversized widgets.
- Adding options to disable aura tracking per unit type.
- Adding option for Aura Colors to not override threat.
- Fixing fonts on auras not applying correctly.
- Adding support for LibOrbitGlow and 'Orbit: Media' glow types.
- Adding last name support for WoW Forever.
- Better handling and more options for aura coloring.
- Some slight improvements to performance.
- Adding CVar options for some clients.
- Adding more dispel glow types and colors.
- Add support for the CustomNames addon.

- Add pandemic glow options for auras.

- Fixing caster name option for buff special.
